## Outcome or question

What useful result are you trying to achieve?

## Current limitation

Give a short, public-safe example and your OIF version/mode if relevant.

## Proposed change (optional)

What would become simpler or more effective? Note compatibility concerns or a
smaller alternative if known. Numerical benefit claims should include their
comparison conditions; estimates are welcome when clearly labeled.
